method: Current working-tree nonbinary text searched with ripgrep for every original relative path, basename and full-file SHA-256; this script recorded matching lines and full referencing-file hashes without matched text or individual private-value digests.
qualification: Only rg-visible text in the working checkout at capture time. Gzip, tar, zip, pack, bundle, binary and ignored symlink targets were excluded, as were indirect computations with no literal path/basename/full-file hash. Basename references may be ambiguous. This is a candidate inventory, not proof of complete dependencies; staged files may change.
